experiment: STARTS S1: concentrate Q=3072 on the TQA start vs historical S4

hypothesis.one_sentence: S8 lost because extra starts starved the TQA trajectory that usually wins; putting the whole Q=3072 on that one start should beat equal four-start C0.
hypothesis.not: No more-starts. No continuation. No free S4. No GR patch.

batch.s2: included; previous N15 L3 32-fit wall was ~100s, not tight

s4_reuse.source: PR82 STARTS S8 audited S4 files

recipe_must_match.start0: TQA, same as S1 start0 and historical C0

s4_reuse.on_mismatch: refit S4, charge Q, never free-count

allocation.S4: Reused if recipe match. Not charged again.
allocation.S1: One start = TQA/start-0. Full Q=3072, K=1531. Same C0 gain/readout. Same SPSA RNG stream as S4 start 0.
allocation.S2: Two equal starts, start0 TQA + start1 U(-0.6,0.6) with the same stream as S4 start 1. K=763 each. Same total Q.
allocation.inclusive: All init, calibration, perturbations, candidates, failures inside each arm Q. No free prefix.

optimizer.kind: ordinary IID Rademacher SPSA, C0 simultaneous gain

selection: Lowest counted candidate energy. F post hoc.

gate.cell: N15 L3 Nov3, n=8, energy E_S1 - E_S4
gate.adopt_S1_as_candidate: bootstrap 95% CI of the mean ΔE lies entirely below 0 AND median ΔE < 0
gate.otherwise: reject S1. Do not scan another concentration.
gate.gr: Do not patch GR even if the gate passes.

report: S1 vs S4 within method: paired Δ(E-E0)/N and ΔF, mean, median, CI, wins, min/max tails
S2 vs S4 same stats, not in the gate
Nov3 vs QAOA under S1 and under S4, same paired stats

ledger.new_charge: 32 new fits × 3072 = 98304 if S1 and S2 both run
